name: Asoko no Koufuku
source:
The theme of the game is metamorphosis.
There are several short fetish stories with different protagonists and progression of interacting with surrounding items at a specific order to answer a fetishist question in each scene.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1989.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
游戏的主题是变形。
有几个简短的恋物癖故事，主角不同，并且按照特定顺序与周围的物品互动，以回答每个场景中的恋物癖问题。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1989.html]vndbreview[/url]]
